classification.difficultyReason: Set up coordinate axes on the supplied blank grid and translate each ordered pair into horizontal and vertical movement, including zero coordinates on axes.

content.prompt: On a Cartesian plane, plot each of the following points. The coordinates of the points are given.

spec.description: Single blank grid for all listed points; students draw their Cartesian axes. Full original 90mm drawing height retained.

answer.worked: From the origin, move $4$ units right and $1$ unit up. Mark and label $A$.
From the origin, move $2$ units left and $3$ units up. Mark and label $B$.
From the origin, move $2$ units left and $2$ units down. Mark and label $C$.
From the origin, move $4$ units right and $1$ unit down. Mark and label $D$.
From the origin, move $1$ unit right and $3$ units up. Mark and label $E$.

answer.short: $F$ is plotted at $(0,-2)$ on the vertical axis.
answer.worked: The horizontal coordinate is $0$, so stay on the vertical axis. Move $2$ units down from the origin and mark $F$.

answer.short: $G$ is plotted at $(-3,0)$ on the horizontal axis.
answer.worked: The vertical coordinate is $0$, so stay on the horizontal axis. Move $3$ units left from the origin and mark $G$.

answer.short: $H$ is plotted at $(0,5)$ on the vertical axis.
answer.worked: The horizontal coordinate is $0$, so stay on the vertical axis. Move $5$ units up from the origin and mark $H$.

spec.description: One shared unit-grid solution graph with all eight labelled points. Ordinary grid, axes, labels and markers use black.
